summary: One visual review pass completed across all 11 camera views against the approved target. Major mismatches affect anatomy, face, dorsal shields, and surface treatment. Arm clearance and every claw cannot be fully verified. No model or repository files were modified. Quality Gate B approval remains with the user.

findings.message: The supplied technical report records a height/depth ratio of 1.2748, below its 1.35 threshold, with zero deterministic blockers. These results were not independently recomputed.
findings.recommendation: Retain this technical warning separately from the visual failures.

findings.message: The model has a rectangular head, plate-like chest, rounded segmented limbs, and a short, nearly straight tail. The target has an elongated reptilian skull, integrated muscular armor, a long curved tail, and prominent fractured dorsal shields. Yellow eyes and luminous armor fissures are not clearly reproduced.
findings.recommendation: Rework the primary anatomy, tail, armor silhouette, and yellow accents to match the approved target.

findings.message: The face close-ups show a box-shaped skull, large rectangular brow or eye covers, a projecting shelf-like mouth, and rectangular side pieces. Bilateral placement is broadly symmetric, but correctly oriented eyes, vents, crown, muzzle, and jaw cannot all be verified as a coherent reptilian face.
findings.recommendation: Reshape and orient the facial components into a readable skull, muzzle, lower jaw, crown, vents, and exposed eyes.

findings.message: Both shoulders visibly attach, but the close-ups show upper-arm forms merging into the shoulder/chest silhouette and crop the lower arms. Full clearance through the elbows, wrists, and adjacent torso or hip volumes cannot be verified.
findings.recommendation: Provide unobstructed views of each entire arm and establish visible clearance below the shoulder attachment.

findings.message: Each foot shows three forward-projecting pale claws, but they read as flat wedges with broad ends rather than curved talons. Some tips are cropped in the close-ups. Rear projections appear in wider views, but each rear claw's backward orientation and exposed tip cannot be conclusively verified.
findings.recommendation: Use tapered talons and capture all three front claws plus the rear claw on each foot without cropping or occlusion.

findings.message: The dorsal assembly reads as overlapping flat slabs with sparse triangular projections. Seven distinct shattered storm shields, their fractured outlines, and their defining yellow fissures are not visually established.
findings.recommendation: Create seven individually readable, irregular fractured shields with varied angular outlines and visible fissures.

criteria.reason: Anatomy, facial construction, proportions, tail curvature, and defining armor silhouette substantially differ from the approved target.
Approximate symmetry is visible, but all required facial parts cannot be verified as correctly oriented and coherently assembled.
Shoulder attachments are visible; complete arm clearance is not verifiable from the cropped close-ups and overlapping silhouettes.
Front claws project forward but appear blunt and slab-like; every tip and both backward-facing rear claws cannot be verified.
Front and side views show an upright trunk supported by the legs, with arms hanging clear of the ground.
The generic segmented biped silhouette does not preserve the target's distinctive reptilian head, integrated armored anatomy, sweeping tail, and shield array.
Seven distinct angular shattered shields cannot be identified; the visible assembly reads primarily as flat overlapping slabs.
Both side views show bent leg profiles with raised heel regions; the substantial thighs and lower legs read as load-bearing and stronger than the short hanging arms.
